sources.fact: Authoritative LBBD23 Brownfield record identifies Ilchester Road Garages.
The record ended on 29 March 2019 and is marked Development complete.
The historic record gives 8 minimum and maximum net dwellings on 0.09ha.
Historic status is permissioned with full-planning-permission dated 9 February 2016.
Historic ownership-status is owned-by-a-public-authority; this is not a current proprietor/title readback.
Brownfield-land record supplies a point and blank geometry.
Planning Data retains an Ilchester Road historical multipolygon; register geometry is not an HMLR title polygon.
Planning Committee considered Ilchester Road 15/01779/FUL together with separate Fitzstephen Road 15/01780/FUL.
Each site comprised six one-bedroom bungalows and two two-bedroom houses; LBBD23 is the eight-home Ilchester component and is not merged with Fitzstephen.
The Board granted planning permission subject to listed conditions.
The minutes describe retirement/adapted and family Council-list homes at affordable rents; tenure/use context does not create a new current candidate.
No current replacement Brownfield record or current redevelopment application for the completed LBBD23 site was verified this wave.

examples.result: LBBD23 is retained as an ended, development-complete historical record.
The eight Ilchester homes are not promoted as a new current candidate.
The separate eight-home Fitzstephen scheme is not merged into LBBD23.
Historic permissioned status is not treated as a new 2026 permission event.
Historic polygon is not converted into an HMLR title polygon.
Historic public-authority category is not current proprietor proof.
Affordable-rent/use details do not create additional dwelling capacity.
Promotion remains zero unless a new current record/case, title relation and overlays are verified.
